ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT,made asof the/ day ofKhuon ,200,byandbetween having an address at 666 Fifth Avenue, Suite 180, New York,New York 10103,and TARA REALTY COMPANY, L.L.C. (the “Owner"), a New York Limited Liability Company, having an office at 120 CedarStreet a/k/a 137-139 Greenwich Street, NewYork,NewYork. WITNESSETH: and improvements constructed or to be constructed thereon, located in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as Tax Lot 10 in Block 52 of the County Tax Map and by the street address 120 Cedar Street a/k/a 137-139 Greenwich Street, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto, (said land is herein referred to as "Owner's Parcel,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof, are herein collectively referred to as “Owner's Building,”’ and said land, building and improvements being herein collectively referred to as the "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer owns that certain tract, plot, and parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements constructed or to be constructed thereon, located in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as Tax Lots 8 in Block 52 of the County Tax Map and by the street address 133 Greenwich Street, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto, said parcel of land is herein referred to as “Developer's Parcel," said buildings and improvements are herein collectively referred to as “Developer's Building,” and said land, building and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein collectively referred to as“Developer's Property"); and WHEREAS,Developer intends,either through Developer or an affiliate thereof, to construct a new or altered building (the“NewBuilding")upon all or a portion of Developer's Parcel and other adjacent parcels and desires to construct a building that contains more floor area(herein referred to as“Floor Area"),as that term is defined in the ZoningResolution of the City of New York effective as of December 15, 1961,as amended (the “Zoning Resolution'), than is now available for use under the Zoning Resolution for Developer's Parcel as an independent “zoning lot,” and so Developer desires to combine the Developer's Parcel and the Owner's Parcel into a single “zoning lot” for the purpose of determining compliance byNewBuildingwith such limitation; and WHEREAS, there exist Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Owner's Property which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution.As used in this Agreement, the term"Floor Area Development Rights" 00209756;11}

shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution,which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of New York (the "City"); and WHEREAS, in order to construct the New Building with the excess bulk on Developer's Parcel, Developer acquired the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) from Owner's Parcel pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Merger Purchase and Sale Agreement between Y.S.F.G.Realty LLC and Owner dated as of February 24,2003 (the "Effective Date") and assigned to (and assumed by) Developer by instrument of even date herewith. As used in this Agreement, "Excess Development Rights" shall mean (i) the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Parcel as of the Effective Date including any and all development rights resulting from any upward revision prior or subsequent to the EffectiveDatebytheCityoftheallowablefloorarearatioandanyandalldevelopmentrights and other benefitswhich maybecome availabletoDeveloper or Owner,less (i) the amount of Floor Area Development Rights utilized by Owner's Building. Owner has agreed to permit Developer to utilize Owner's Excess Development Rights, on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner is retaining for its own benefit all Floor Area Development Rights and all other rights pertaining to Owner's Building and Owner's Parcel as same exists as of the Effective Date excluding however, any floor area and development rights resulting from any upward revisions after the Effective Date by the City of the allowable floor area ratio (such Floor Area Development Rights being retained by Owner, minus such exclusion, are referred to herein as the "Owner's Floor Area"); and WHEREAS,Owner and Developer desire to set forth the rights and obligations of each with respect to development and certain related activities on their respective portions of the single zoninglot tobe created simultaneously herewith: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the covenants and agreements herein contained,theparties heretohereby covenant and agree asfollows: Article I DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution(herein called the“Declaration")which seeks toeffectuate theintentions of the Owner and Developer to create the single Zoning Lot comprising both Owner's Parcel and the Developer's Parcel (hereinafter the “Single Zoning Lot"). {00209756;11} 2
